title: Devil's Arcade
description:
Escape from the Devil's latest creation. In Devil's Arcade, hordes of demons, a bunch of different game modes, and randomized events await you.

Features• 2D top-down shooter with tower defense elements: Fight off waves of demons and prevent them from corrupting your soul at the center of the arena.

• The Power-Shot Ability: Use the mighty power-shot to keep the upperhand.

• The Dash Ability: Quickly maneuver around the demon hordes with the dash ability.

• The Devil's Dice: Corrupted dice trigger a variety of events during battle, which can affect both your strength, as well as that of the Demons.

Content• 10+ unique kinds of demons,

• 90+ different dice-events,

• 16+ unique game modes,

• 4 different bonus minigames at the end of a round,

• Unlockable bonuses,

• Endless fun for casuals
description_short: Escape from the Devil's latest creation! In the 2D top-down shooter Devil's Arcade, hordes of demons, a bunch of different game modes, randomized events and endless fun awaits you!
